record.paper_title: Recent results on functional equations in a single variable, perspectives and open problems
record.original_question: Classify the continuous real-valued solutions φ:R→R of the functional equation φ(x + φ(x)) = φ(x)φ(x + 1). A conjecture quoted in the survey states that the only continuous solutions are quadratic polynomials.

evidence.quote: Regarding solutions ϕ : R → R of (3.7) with k = 1: ϕ(x + ϕ(x)) = ϕ(x)ϕ(x + 1) (3.8) let us mention the paper [228] by S. L. Segal where, among others, the following conjecture is posed: The only continuous solutions ϕ : R → R of (3.8) are quadratic polynomials.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Determine all continuous functions φ : ℝ → ℝ satisfying the functional equation
   φ(x + φ(x)) = φ(x) · φ(x + 1)   for every x ∈ ℝ.
In particular, decide whether the only continuous solutions are quadratic polynomials (i.e., functions of the form φ(x) = ax² + bx + c with a, b, c ∈ ℝ that satisfy the above identity), or exhibit a continuous solution that is not a quadratic polynomial.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not surface a published resolution of this conjecture (attributed to S. L. Segal) classifying the continuous real solutions of φ(x+φ(x)) = φ(x)φ(x+1). No counterexample or proof that all continuous solutions are quadratic polynomials was found in accessible sources, so the current status appears unresolved, but this could not be verified definitively.

status_evidence.title: On continuous solutions of a functional equation (Dankiewicz)
status_evidence.snippet: 1997 article in Annales Polonici Mathematici on continuous solutions of a functional equation; full text not available to confirm relevance to Segal's equation.
status_evidence.claim: No accessible source confirms a proof or refutation of the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Search results for Segal conjecture functional equation
status_evidence.snippet: Search returns no direct resolution of the conjecture that all continuous solutions of φ(x+φ(x))=φ(x)φ(x+1) are quadratic polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Status of the conjecture could not be determined from web search.
